source_caption:
According to Paolo Sorrentino, it was Alfonso Cuarón’s Roma (2018), which was based on Cuaron’s childhood in Mexico City, that gave Sorrentino the idea to commit his own life story to film. For Sorrentino realized that “a personal film could tell a universal story.”⁣
⁣⁣
He spent years gathering memories about his family, friends and parents before writing the screenplay in his typical process: very fast, taking not longer than two weeks, using the notes on the facts, ideas and characters, and possible dialogues that took years to accumulate. ⁣
⁣⁣
How do you guys rate 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐇𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝 (𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟏) out of ten? 👀

source_details.title: Roma
source_details.synopsis: Roma is a 2018 historical drama film written, produced, and directed by Alfonso Cuarón, who also served as cinematographer and co-editor. Set in 1970 and 1971, Roma follows the life of a live-in indigenous mixteca housekeeper of an upper-middle-class Mexican family. It is a semi-autobiographical take on Cuarón's upbringing in Mexico City's Colonia Roma neighborhood. The film stars Yalitza Aparicio and Marina de Tavira. It is an international co-production between Mexico and the United States. Roma premiered on 30 August 2018 at the 75th Venice International Film Festival, where it won the Golden Lion.
